sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation

Monika Zellner

sup:70410.subject: Seal 24 mm – reciprocal proposal for full allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We would like to propose a reciprocal package: EUR 29.89/unit, 23,400 units binding in each year, 24 months, DAP, with your 54-day lead time.

On delivery, we would accept 54 days instead of the 42-day standard lead time recorded in our framework agreement (ctr:4600070410#5.1), giving you more scheduling room. On commitment, your capacity letter of 18 September 2026 (doc:20260918-70410-P10) says you will prioritise customers with firm, long-term commitments; we offer exactly that with a firm two-year commitment. In return, we ask for full allocation of 23,400 units per year at EUR 29.89/unit.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); it is a buyer benchmark, not your disclosed cost.

Payment 30 days, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling remain as in the enquiry.

Does this trade work for you?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Seal 24 mm – reciprocal proposal for full allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your proposal for a 24-month commitment and an increased volume of 23,400 units. We can accommodate this full allocation with the requested 54-day lead time. 

However, your cost estimate does not reflect our manufacturing realities; we can offer EUR 31.70 per unit for this package. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days. Which volume can you commit to? This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Seal 24 mm – three-year commitment proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for confirming full allocation with the 54-day lead time. To answer your question: we can commit to 23,400 units per year, binding in each year. We propose extending the term to 36 months.

Our September planning forecast was 21,310 units (fc:340010@2026-09). It is historical planning data, not a commitment. We now propose a binding 23,400 units in each of three years, totaling 70,200 units if this package is agreed.

Our proposal is EUR 31.07/unit, 23,400 units/year, 36 months, 54 days, DAP. We move from EUR 29.89 to EUR 31.07/unit and add a third committed year. We also accept 54 days instead of the 42-day standard recorded in our framework agreement (ctr:4600070410 §5.1).

EUR 31.07 is our commercial proposal in exchange for this firm volume and the delivery flexibility. It is not a disclosed supplier cost or a budget restriction. We ask that the complete price recognise this reciprocal commitment.

Payment 30 days, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling remain unchanged.

Could you confirm this package?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Seal 24 mm – three-year commitment proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We verified your planning forecast data; it does not alter our commercial baseline. 

We accept the proposed 36-month contract term for 23,400 units per year. In exchange for this extended commitment, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.50 per unit.

For our Angebot, our terms remain a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer stays valid for 7 days. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
